chunks: By this chain of narration, he said: Al-Sadiq Jafar ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) would say:
For every people is a government they watch for, and our government will manifest at the end of time.

key_terms.آخر الدهر: The end of time — eschatological reference to the era of the Mahdi
key_terms.دولة: Government, state, period of rule — here referring to divinely-ordained governance

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the government of the Ahlulbayt at the end of time?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) recited a poetic verse expressing the Shia eschatological belief in the advent of the Mahdi. The verse conveys that just as every nation has its period of governance, the rule of the Ahlulbayt will come at the end of time. This was a commonly expressed hope among the followers of the Imams, referring to the expected appearance of the twelfth Imam who would establish justice on earth.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad, he said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) would say:
For every people is a government that they draw near to, And our government at the End of Time will manifest.
